faq.metaDescription: Frequently asked questions and answers about Hirovo. Information about job searching, applying and using the application.

q1.question: What is Hirovo?
q1.answer: Hirovo is a mobile employment platform that brings together job seekers and employers. You can search among thousands of job postings, apply with a single click, and follow career opportunities.

q2.question: Is Hirovo free?
q2.answer: Yes, Hirovo is completely free for job seekers. You can use all our features for free.

q3.question: Where can I download Hirovo?
q3.answer: You can download Hirovo for free from Google Play Store. The iOS version will be released soon.

q1.question: How can I create an account?
q1.answer: After downloading the application, you can register in seconds with your e-mail address or phone number.

q2.question: I forgot my password, what should I do?
q2.answer: You can reset your password via e-mail or SMS by clicking the 'Forgot My Password' option on the login screen.

q3.question: How can I delete my account?
q3.answer: You can request account deletion from the in-app settings or from the 'Account Deletion' page on our website.

q1.question: How do I track my application?
q1.answer: You can see all your applications and their status in the 'My Applications' section in the application.

q2.question: Can I withdraw my application?
q2.answer: Yes, you can withdraw your applications that have not been reviewed yet.

q3.question: Why was my application rejected?
q3.answer: Employers make evaluations according to their own criteria. You can increase your chances by updating your profile and applying to more postings.

q1.question: How to open a company account?
q1.answer: You can register your company through the application or on our website. The verification process is completed within 24-48 hours.

q2.question: Is there a fee to publish an ad?
q2.answer: Our basic package is free. For more announcements and advanced features, you can check out our professional packages.

q1.question: The application does not open, what should I do?
q1.answer: First update the application. If the problem persists, delete the app and reinstall it. If you are still having problems, contact our support team.

q2.question: Notifications not coming?
q2.answer: Make sure you allow notifications for Hirovo in your phone settings. Also check your notification preferences in in-app settings.

resume1.title: How to Prepare an Effective CV?
resume1.summary: A professional CV preparation guide that attracts the attention of employers.
resume1.content:
Your CV is the first impression of your job application. A well-prepared CV distinguishes you from other candidates and increases your chances of receiving an interview invitation. Here are tips for an effective CV: 

1. Use a clear and concise format 
2. Highlight your relevant experiences 
3. Support your concrete achievements with numbers 
4. Use keywords correctly 
5. Check carefully for errors

resume2.title: Most Common Mistakes Made in CV
resume2.summary: CV mistakes that could cause your applications to be rejected and how to avoid them.
resume2.content: Many candidates make critical mistakes in their CVs without realizing it. Recognizing and correcting these mistakes will speed up your job finding process.

interview1.title: Secrets of Success in Interviews
interview1.summary: Techniques you need to know to be successful in job interviews.
interview1.content: The interview is the most critical stage of the job application process. Well-prepared candidates can handle stress and express themselves at their best.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Hirovo Privacy Policy - Information about how your personal data is collected, used and protected.
privacy.intro: At Hirovo, we attach great importance to the privacy of our users. This Privacy Policy explains how personal data we collect through the Hirovo mobile application ("Application") is processed.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.intro: We may collect the following information when you use our application:

items.account: Account Information: Name, surname, e-mail address, phone number
items.profile: Profile Information: CV, work experience, educational information, skills
items.location: Location Information: Location data to display job postings near you (with your permission)
items.device: Device Information: Device tour, operating system, application version
items.usage: Usage Data: In-app interactions, ads viewed, applications

section2.title: 2. Purposes of Use of Information
section2.intro: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

items.jobs: Showing job postings suitable for you
items.applications: Forwarding your job applications to employers

section3.title: 3. Sharing of Information
section3.intro: We do not share your personal data with third parties except in the following cases:

items.employers: Employers: We share your profile information with the owners of the job postings you apply to.
items.providers: Service Providers: Trusted partners who provide technical services necessary for the operation of our application.
items.legal: Legal Obligations: In accordance with legal processes or the request of competent authorities

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.intro: We implement industry standard security measures to protect your personal data:

section5.title: 5. Your rights
section5.intro: You have the following rights within the scope of the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK):

items.know: Learning whether your personal data is being processed or not
items.info: Requesting information about your personal data if it has been processed
items.purpose: Learning the purpose of processing your personal data and whether they are used for their intended purpose
items.thirdParty: Knowing the third parties to whom personal data is transferred at home or abroad
items.correct: Requesting correction of personal data if they are incomplete or incorrectly processed
items.delete: Request deletion or destruction of your personal data

section6.title: 6. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
section6.content: Our app may use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience. Thanks to these technologies, we remember your preferences and analyze application performance.

section7.title: 7. Children's Privacy
section7.content: Our application is not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from persons under 18 years of age.

section8.title: 8. Policy Changes
section8.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. In case of significant changes, we will notify you with in-app notifications.

section9.title: 9. Communication
section9.intro: For your privacy-related questions, you can contact us:

terms.intro: By using the Hirovo mobile application ("Application") you are deemed to have accepted the following terms of use. Please read these terms carefully.

items.view: You can view job postings and apply
items.profile: You can create your professional profile

section2.title: 2. Account Creation and Security
section2.intro: You need to create an account to use our application. When creating an account:

items.accurate: You agree to provide accurate and current information
items.responsible: You are responsible for the confidentiality of your account information.

section3.intro: When using our application you agree to comply with the following rules:

items.legal: Acting in accordance with laws and regulations
items.respect: Respecting the rights of other users

section4.intro: The following behaviors are strictly prohibited:
